name: Player and QoL
description: Everyday helpers: middle click item use, one key to switch every module off, chat macros, respawn and reconnect, fishing, and developer recorders.

addons.MiddleClick: Middle click uses a chosen hotbar item (pearl, rod or golden apple). Leaves the friend toggle alone when you aim at a player.
addons.PanicKey: One key turns every other module off, and back on when pressed again.
addons.AutoRespawn: Presses Respawn after a random delay when you die.
addons.ChatMacros: Sends a chat line when a key is pressed, written as KEY=message pairs.
addons.AutoReconnect: Reconnects to the last server after a disconnect, with a delay and a retry limit.
addons.AutoFish: Casts a fishing rod and reels in when you get a bite.
